summary: Some distros return missing or default fact values because packages needed for fact gathering are not installed by default. For example, Linux network facts depend on the ip binary from the iproute2 package.
questions: Why are my network facts empty on a minimal Linux install?
What package do I need for Ansible to gather network interface facts?
Some facts show default values on my hosts. What's missing?

answer_card.title: Missing network facts on minimal hosts
answer_card.answer_md: Network fact gathering on Linux needs the `ip` binary, usually provided by the `iproute2` package. If facts are missing or show defaults, install the supporting packages on the remote hosts with the OS package manager.
